items: Prepared for {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}}
Meridian Actuarial Advisors
Presented by Jennifer Vasquez, Consulting Actuary
No valuation results appear in this briefing. Results follow once the data are final and the assumptions are agreed.
Jennifer Vasquez, Consulting Actuary: leads the valuation and is your first contact.
David Sherman, Senior Analyst: valuation model, census loading, and reconciliation.
Jeffrey Ochoa, Actuarial Analyst: plan experience and the assumption review.
Elizabeth Horne, Director of Operations: census data, plan documents, and decisions for {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}}.
Work began on {{fact:f:E-2016-001.start}}.
The participant census has been received and loaded into the valuation model.
Active and retiree records reconcile to the prior year's file.
Some terminated vested records do not yet reconcile. Our questions on them are with your staff.
The current plan document and its amendments have been requested.
Data: the census and plan provisions as you provide them. We test them for consistency and completeness. We do not audit them.
Assumptions: our proposals for future experience, each reviewed with you before it is used.
Conclusions: the liabilities and costs that follow from the data and the assumptions together.
We report the three separately, so the effect of any change can be traced to its source.
Mortality: whether to adopt the RP-2014 table with the MP-2015 improvement scale.
Retirement and termination rates: tested against the plan's own experience before any change is proposed.
Economic assumptions: each proposed with its basis stated in writing.
Any item set by regulation is identified as prescribed, not presented as a choice.
Close the open terminated vested questions with your staff.
Code the amended plan provisions once the documents arrive.
Send a written summary of the data and provisions before any assumption is applied.
Hold a working session on the demographic assumptions.
Preliminary results follow agreement on the assumptions.
